concepts.subject: Diverse office team meeting
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a photo of a diverse office team in a meeting room with natural light, warm colors, and a collaborative mood. Include a mix of ages, ethnicities, and abilities. Camera angle is slightly above, looking down on the team. Specific details include laptops, notepads, and a whiteboard.
concepts.title: Diverse Office Team Meeting Discussion
concepts.description: A group of diverse office workers sitting around a conference table, engaged in a discussion. The room is filled with natural light and the atmosphere is collaborative.

concepts.subject: Active senior woman outdoors
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a photo of an active senior woman hiking outdoors, with a sunny sky, vibrant greenery, and a sense of freedom. Camera angle is behind the subject, looking out at the landscape. Specific details include a hiking trail, trees, and a walking stick.
concepts.title: Senior Woman Hiking Outdoors Alone
concepts.description: An active senior woman hiking alone on a trail, surrounded by nature and enjoying the scenery. She is walking with a stick and has a backpack on.

concepts.subject: Fresh fruit salad bowl
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a photo of a fresh fruit salad bowl, with a bright and colorful arrangement, natural light, and a appetizing mood. Include a mix of exotic and common fruits. Camera angle is directly above, looking down on the bowl. Specific details include a wooden spoon and a sprinkle of coconut flakes.
concepts.title: Fresh Fruit Salad Bowl With Exotic Fruits
concepts.description: A colorful bowl of fresh fruit salad, containing a variety of exotic and common fruits, garnished with coconut flakes and served with a wooden spoon.

concepts.title: Serene Mountain Lake Landscape At Sunrise
